title: The courtyard where old Yazhou studied
summary: In Sanya’s Yazhou district, the historic Yazhou Academy served as both a Confucian temple and a government-run school. The two roles bring education and ritual together in one place. If you are exploring the old town, pause at the academy and think of the grounds as a place where learning had a public and ceremonial role.

sections.heading: A school and a temple in one setting
sections.text: The district’s heritage inventory identifies the academy in Yacheng Village beside Yacheng Primary School. It describes the historic site as a Confucian temple as well as an official school. The pairing offers a way to understand why a place for study could also have a ceremonial layout.

visitNote: Check current access and the visitor entrance with the site before setting out.
